creator: OutmodedElectronics
description: Fender '62 Deluxe full-rig captures by OutmodedElectronics: amp, speaker and microphone together, with no additional cabinet IR required. Bright-channel settings range from Clean to Edge in this collection. In the filenames, V is Volume and T is Tone; SM57 identifies the microphone. Input reference: 11.5 dBu; output reference: 11.7 dBu. Settings and calibration are taken from the supplied files; an exact public pack page was not found.
